enabled.title: Enable Ohme EV Charger
enabled.description: Poll the Ohme cloud API for live charge telemetry

email.title: Ohme account email
email.description: Email address used to sign in to the Ohme app

password.title: Ohme account password
password.description: Password used to sign in to the Ohme app (stored on-device only)

ev_inside_ct.title: Charger is inside the inverter CT clamp
ev_inside_ct.description: On when the inverter's meter can see the EV charge load — the house battery could otherwise drain into the car. Off for chargers wired grid-side of the CT (discharge hold and load corrections are skipped; charge windows still publish).

hold_discharge_while_charging.title: Hold battery discharge while EV charges
hold_discharge_while_charging.description: Pause battery discharge whenever the charger reports real draw — stops the house battery feeding the car

hold_during_planned_slots.title: Hold during claimed charge windows
hold_during_planned_slots.description: Also hold battery discharge during Ohme's planned charge windows while plugged in — cheap insurance when the charger starts before telemetry catches up (the window is cheap-rate anyway)

hold_soc_floor.title: Hold release SOC floor (%)
hold_soc_floor.description: Release the discharge hold early if house battery SOC falls to this level (secondary failsafe)

cocharge_during_slots.title: Co-charge battery during EV windows
cocharge_during_slots.description: Publish planned EV charge windows to the Energy Planner at the pseudo-rate below so it can schedule battery charging alongside the car

ev_slot_rate_pence.title: EV window pseudo-rate (p/kWh)
ev_slot_rate_pence.description: Rate the planner assumes during EV charge windows — set to your off-peak price (e.g. Intelligent Go 7p)

supply_limit_amps.title: Main supply fuse rating (A)
supply_limit_amps.description: Household supply limit — EV + battery co-charging is suppressed if combined draw would exceed this

headroom_amps.title: Household headroom (A)
headroom_amps.description: Amps to reserve for ordinary house load when checking co-charge feasibility against the supply limit

publish_slots_unplugged.title: Publish charge windows while unplugged
publish_slots_unplugged.description: Keep feeding planned windows to the planner even when no car is connected (Octopus dispatches can persist after unplug)

poll_idle_s.title: Idle poll interval (seconds)
poll_idle_s.description: Seconds between Ohme API polls when no charge is active or imminent

poll_active_s.title: Active poll interval (seconds)
poll_active_s.description: Seconds between polls while charging, pending approval, or inside a planned window
